title: Air Strike on Calarcá Dissidents' Frente 33 Camp in Catatumbo
detail: President de la Espriella announced a pre-dawn bombing by Kfir and Super Tucano aircraft on a Frente 33 (Calarcá faction) camp between Tibú and El Tarra, Norte de Santander, where 20+ fighters were reportedly present. It is the first such strike since a court halted bombings and the fourth under his administration; results were still to be reported. Defence Minister Jorge Eduardo Mora later gave a final toll of four Frente 33 members killed, including a 16-year-old girl, and three soldiers hurt by a minefield. Troops found three camps able to hold 36 fighters, a bunker and explosives-preparation areas, and seized 10 rifles and over 3,860 cartridges. The girl's death revived the debate over child recruitment; a Bogotá court ordered a precaution protocol for bombings involving minors in September.
